subject: Bridging remediation & credit plan for Nov 16–17 latency incident
messages:
From: Ellie Park <ellie@vanguardai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@vanguardai.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12 -0800
Subject: Production latency spike and request for remediation credits (Nov 16-17)

Marcus —

We observed sustained tail latency and frequent 502s across our inference pipeline on Nov 16 (21:00–23:30 PST) and intermittent latency on Nov 17 (02:15–03:10 PST). This materially affected customer-facing features and caused multiple feature flags to be toggled off. Our engineering team has attached a short impact summary (see impact_report.csv) showing 14% request error increase and a 300ms median latency uplift for affected endpoints during that window.

Vanguard expects us to follow the SLA remediation path — please advise what credit/cost offset Redwood will provide for the impacted usage and timeline for applying any adjustments to our invoices. We also need a short summary of mitigation steps so we can communicate to our customers.

Regards,
Ellie Park
Head of Platform, Vanguard AI

Attachments: impact_report.csv (CSV, 42 KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Park <ellie@vanguardai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:30 -0800
Subject: Re: Production latency spike and request for remediation credits (Nov 16-17)

Hi Ellie —

First, I want to apologize for the disruption; this is not the experience we aim to deliver. Thank you for the clear impact data — that was helpful. Preliminary read: the incident spanned ~2.5 hours on 11/16 with follow-up degradation on 11/17 for ~55 mins.

Proposal (initial, non-final):
- Immediate: we will issue an invoice credit equal to 50% of the pro-rated daily usage charges for the two primary impact days. That should reflect on your next invoice as a line item credit.
- Follow-up: pending internal approval we are proposing a one-time additional credit calculated as 10% of the impacted-month usage spend, capped at $50k. This is an exception beyond standard SLA language and requires exec signoff.

Can Karthik and Lauren help scope the one-time exception and confirm GL posting, timing, and whether we should disperse the credit across two billing cycles? I will attach the raw logs and the impact summary in a follow-up.

-Marcus
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachment: placeholder for logs (will send CSVs in thread)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 13:05 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Re: Production latency spike — exec approval request for one-time credit

Folks — forwarding Vanguard's ask and Marcus's initial plan. Key points for approval review:
- Customer impact: production degradation affecting paid customers during a high-traffic evening window. Vanguard is a strategic PLG account with heavy growth in Q4; churn risk is material.
- Financials: Vanguard's expected monthly bill is ~$120k; impacted usage estimated ~$21k for the affected period. Marcus proposes 10% of monthly impacted spend (~$2.1k) but capping the exception at $50k — I recommend we consider a negotiated number nearer to $45k given retention considerations.
- Requested ask: exec signoff for one-time credit up to $48k, to be applied as a combination of an immediate invoice credit and a follow-on credit split across the next two invoices (to avoid a single-period hit).

Please advise final number and approval path. If Lauren signs off from finance, I will route to Legal for the amendment and to the CFO for authorization of the one-off.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference

--- Forwarded impact summary and calculation (see attachments) ---

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:02 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Production latency spike — exec approval request for one-time credit

Thanks for the context. A few items I need before I can approve:
1) A concise cost-breakdown: impacted usage dollars by day and the proposed credit math (line-item calculation). The impact_report.csv is helpful but I need invoice-level numbers and the GL code for credits.
2) Confirmation on how the credit will appear on invoices (credit memo vs negative line item). Our accounting prefers credit memos tied to invoice IDs.
3) Proposed posting schedule: immediate partial credit on next invoice (amount A) + remaining credit on following invoice (amount B). Please propose A/B split.
4) Legal routing: if the final credit exceeds $25k we need an amendment approved by Legal. If we land under $25k, finance can handle.

If you can send the invoice list and the token-usage to dollar mapping I can sign off quickly.

-Lauren Bishop
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachment request: invoices_nov_sept_2026.pdf (please attach)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ellie Park <ellie@vanguardai.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 03:20 -0800
Subject: Re: Bridging remediation & credit plan for Nov 16–17 latency incident

Lauren — attached are the two files you requested (impact_report.csv and invoices_nov_sept_2026.pdf). Quick reconciliation:
- Affected spend (pro-rated across Nov billing): $18,900
- Proposed remediation: immediate credit = $9,450 (50% of pro-rated days) applied as a credit memo on the next invoice; additional one-time exception = $38,550 (to reach the negotiated one-off $48k total), split as $19,275 on the following invoice and $19,275 on the subsequent invoice.
- Rationale: split reduces single-period impact and smooths customer accounting.

Ellie — if this aligns with Vanguard's expectation, please confirm and we'll move to finalize the credit memos. Lauren — please confirm GL code 4115-CREDIT and whether Legal needs to draft a short amendment; Karthik, please route to CFO if you agree with the $48k cap.

Thanks — Marcus

Attachments: impact_report.csv (CSV), invoices_nov_sept_2026.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ellie Park <ellie@vanguardai.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 20:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Bridging remediation & credit plan for Nov 16–17 latency incident — Finance approval

Approved from finance: authorize a one-time credit of $48,000 to Vanguard AI to resolve the Nov 16–17 incident. Posting instructions:
- Credit memo 1 (next invoice): $9,450 (immediate pro-rated credit) + $19,275 (first tranche of exception) = $28,725 tied to Invoice #2026-11-0012.
- Credit memo 2 (following invoice): $19,275 tied to Invoice #2026-12-0017.
- GL code: 4115-CREDIT. Please route to Legal only for record amendment; no further CFO approval required given the mitigation and customer risk.

Ellie: once you confirm acceptance of the schedule I will instruct Accounting to generate the credit memos.

-Lauren Bishop
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Bcc: accounting@redwood.com
